video_title: Kyrie and LeBron James are the BEST DUO over the last 20 years 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues LeBron James and Kyrie Irving are the best duo
quotes.excerpt: There is no better talents than Bron and Kyrie as a duo.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: LeBron and Kyrie are staying. There is no better talents than Bron and Kyrie as a duo. I don't care who you are talking about up there. As far as pure talent together, them two are the best.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: All of them have championships except for Kevin Durant and Russell Westbrook. So for me, for that reason, you are out.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That best duo didn't win. You got two MVPs, but that best duo didn't win.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson defends Tim Duncan and Tony Parker's inclusion
quotes.excerpt: I don't know how you keep Tim Duncan and Tony Parker off this list.
quotes.quote: I don't know how you keep Tim Duncan and Tony Parker off this list. They have four championships. I don't know how, and I played against them. I don't know how you keep Tim Duncan and Tony Parker off this list.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton explains his decision to cut Kevin Garnett and Paul Pierce
quotes.excerpt: Boston wasn't the best Kevin Garnett we seen. Best Kevin Garnett we seen was Minnesota.
quotes.quote: I'm taking Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson out. I'm taking Kevin Durant and Russell Westbrook and Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett out. Because Boston wasn't the best Kevin Garnett we seen. Best Kevin Garnett we seen was Minnesota, his first stint. They only got one together, right? So you are telling me you are keeping them?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the unique impact of Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson
quotes.excerpt: The Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson dynamic is something I don't know if we'll ever see again.
quotes.quote: The Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson dynamic is something I don't know if we'll ever see again. I can find another Kobe Bryant, but I can find a Pau Gasol. There is a lot of players we know that are better than Pau Gasol. Klay Thompson is one of the best shooters I have ever seen. Stephen Curry is the best shooter I have ever seen. Them two motherfuckers are way more dangerous together than Kobe and Pau are. Way more dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues Kobe Bryant is the second best player ever
quotes.excerpt: Kobe Bryant is my number two of all time for me.
quotes.quote: Kobe Bryant is my number two of all time for me. I'm not taking him off my list. That's my number two.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson claims the entire NBA had to change for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: There is a reason the whole league had to change for these guys.
quotes.quote: There is a reason the whole league had to change for these guys. There is a reason the league had to migrate to a whole another style. They changed the way of basketball. Since 2014, the whole league had to change the way them motherfuckers play.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton defends the Lakers' championship pedigree
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers team, two times they won the championship.
quotes.quote: The Lakers team, two times they won the championship. They were them motherfuckers with Lamar Odom in there.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the conflict of styles in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's a conflict of styles. That's all it comes down to.
quotes.quote: It's a conflict of styles. That's all it comes down to. The spacing that those motherfuckers bring to what the it's going to be very hard to beat a team that scores more than you. The game is to put the ball in the basket. They will score the ball more.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson insists LeBron James is the best guard on the list
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is the best guard up there.
quotes.quote: LeBron James is the best guard up there.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on LeBron James's NBA Finals record
quotes.excerpt: The guy went to nine straight finals.
quotes.quote: The guy went to nine straight finals. If you went to nine straight finals, no one can talk shit to you. You went to nine straight.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the defensive versatility of Klay Thompson
quotes.excerpt: Klay Thompson was probably top two, top three two-way player in the league at his prime.
quotes.quote: Klay Thompson was probably top two, top three two-way player in the league at his prime. He was going to get fried. I'm not arguing. You had Andre. They all going to get fried, Ray. But once again, there is a reason since 2014, the whole league changed.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva notes Tony Parker's paint scoring
quotes.excerpt: Tony Parker led the league in paint points.
quotes.quote: Tony Parker led the league in paint points.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the shooting efficiency of Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson
quotes.excerpt: The lowest this nigga Klay Thompson is shooting three is 38 percent.
quotes.quote: The lowest this nigga Klay Thompson is shooting three is 38 percent. I mean, them two motherfuckers are shooting threes at a high clip. The lowest this nigga Klay Thompson is shooting three is 38 percent.
